text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Election task-force meets to prepare parliamentary poll planned for the first half of 1997.
- As "terrorism" has no borders, Algeria expects the Arab League to adopt a plan to intensify the struggle against this phenomenon, foreign to Moslem society.
- Some party leaders sitting in the National Transitional Council walk out from its meeting over party legislation.
- Algeria will invite observers from the United Nations, Organisation for African Unity and Arab League to supervise general elections this year.
- Calls for interference in Algeria's internal affairs multiply in France: Sermonisers wake up there.
